anomalies.description: A dark SUV loses traction on the wet road, veers sharply left across the lane markings, and collides with the left guardrail (visible at f13–f15). The vehicle’s rear wheels lift slightly during impact, and spray is violently displaced.

A red truck collides with or closely passes a black sedan parked on the right side of the road, generating a large dust cloud and causing visible damage to the sedan's rear. The truck then continues forward, partially obscuring the view.
A red truck collides with the camera vehicle, causing a sudden impact and dust cloud that obscures the view; the front of the camera vehicle is struck on the left side.
